description: Cross-session agent question board — injects open questions from schmug/agent-notes at session start. Pairs with the ask-board skill.

hooks.command: q=$(gh discussion list -R schmug/agent-notes --state open --limit 20 --json number,title,answered,category --jq '.discussions[]|select(.answered==false)|"#\(.number) \(.title)\(if .category.name!="Q&A" then "  [!! MISFILED in \(.category.name) - cannot be answered, move to Q&A]" else "" end)"' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$q" ] && jq -nc --arg q "$q" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Open agent questions (answer only if your work happens to cover it; do not chase):\n"+$q)}}'; true
